svg.title: F18-7 Pump suction strainer and side-stream filter on one FWS pump set
svg.text: Strainer ΔP clean at design flow
F18-7 Pump suction strainer and side-stream filter on one FWS pump set
hall FWS 232 L/s · side-stream 5 % = 11.6 L/s through a 10 µm bag filter · filter clean ΔP 0.2 bar, change at 1.0 bar · strainer clean ΔP 8 kPa at design flow · inspection
• The side-stream flow is 5 % of the 232 L/s hall flow, 11.6 L/s, measured with a clamp-on meter and written on the filter commissioning sheet.
• Every strainer has a gauge pair; the register entry for B2-DH1-FWS-STR-CDU08 shows 8 kPa clean, 31 kPa at the 02 Oct 2026 inspection, and the temporary basket
instrument bubble (ISA 5.1): letters = measured variable + function
